summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of the rewritten Summon page (/summon) single-viewport layout. All core features verified: Hero/Gear mode toggle, Pay mode toggle (Gems/Ryo), Pity module, all summon buttons (x1/x10/ticket for both Hero and Gear modes), and all dialogs (Rates, Available/Roster, Featured, History) open/close correctly with proper data-testid attributes.

Pay mode toggle Gems/Ryo updates button costs correctly (data-testid: pay-gems, pay-ryo)
Pity module renders with correct elements (data-testid: summon-pity-module, summon-pity-count-text, pulls-to-pity) showing 57/90 pity count
Summon x1 button found and functional (data-testid: summon-x1-button)
Summon x10 button found and functional (data-testid: summon-x10-button)

Roster/Available dialog opens correctly (data-testid: open-available-card, available-dialog) with element filters (element-filters) functional
Featured dialog opens correctly (data-testid: view-all-featured, featured-dialog) showing featured heroes grid
History dialog opens correctly (data-testid: open-history-card, summon-history-dialog) showing empty state message

Gear mode: gear-x10-button found and functional
